response.text: {"question":"As of 30 April 2026, what actions must the State Nodal Officer take when they become aware of transactions or attempts by a third party that could benefit individuals or entities on the designated list under the Prevention of Money‑Laundering Act?","answer":"The State Nodal Officer must promptly notify the Central Nodal Officer and the DGP/Commissioner of Police of the State/UT to initiate appropriate action.","answerable":true}
